products.description: The CRYSTAL Automatic Video Measuring System with Cabinet is engineered for high-precision, efficient, and repeatable dimensional inspection across demanding quality control applications. Precision & Reliability: Robust automatic measurement performance with an integrated cabinet solution for dependable quality inspection. Productivity & Efficiency: Automated measurement capabilities significantly streamline inspection processes, helping reduce measurement time and improve throughput. hardware_features: Using high accuracy and stability granite as machine base and column
Reducing Mechanical Error and Ensuring Horizontal Motion Accuracy of X and Y with Two - layer Table Structure
Granite worktable surface is not easy to scratch and durable
Worktable X, Y axis high verticality, ensure coordinate measurement accuracy up to 2.5+L/100µm
Balance hammer structure for Z axis lifting to ensure smooth lifting
Single axis accuracy：2.5+L/100µm
software_features: The software has the function similar to EXCEL. The measurement data and EXCEL data seamless connection
The automatic output tolerance can be told by color, sound and mark, especially the product can be tracked.

The sub-pixel measurement function is introduced for the first time, and there is no requirement for the surveyor. Saving measurement time for users improves measurement efficiency compared with peer products
Complex graphics including curves can be measured
